name: Into the Depths
label: Quest
description: Into the Depths: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Inside the temple, I found a circular room with six balconies, each one with a serpent statue on the edge. Curious, I pushed one of them to see what would happen, and it was a trap! I nearly fell to my death from the explosion. Laying there on the ledge, I looked down and noticed that there was another statue at the base of the room; an altar of sorts... Hakkar, I think it was called.
I think that this altar is the secret -- you must bring this token to the altar in the Sunken Temple.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Upon examining the statue, you notice a depression in its side, just the size of the token that Marvon gave you...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You push the stone circle into the opening, and you hear it lock into place.
Now that the stone is in place, you may continue... But what should you do next?
Perhaps you should examine this altar further...
